# Synthetic document fixtures

`text.pdf` contains two pages of fictional project text in Chinese and English. `scan.pdf` contains a raster image with English and Chinese OCR test text. Both were generated locally for this test suite, contain no personal materials, and can be redistributed with it.

Other fixtures (DOCX, encrypted PDF, Markdown, invalid files) are generated by the standard-library test suite in a temporary directory. Tests run with Python 3.9+ and the included parser; no ReportLab, Pillow or python-docx installation is needed to execute them.
